'''Marcellus "Marc" Swint''' is an American voice actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Swint was born on June 18, 1987, in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. As an adult, he became a voice actor and worked on a number of English-dubbed versions of Japanese anime series, as well as video games. Starting in 2017, he voiced {{an|Kiawe}} in {{aniseries|SM}} of the {{pkmn|animated series}}.
